page.overview:
What is Vindeedee?

Vindeedee were creatures native to Ataegina that could be identified by their piercing, high-pitched call that humans mimicked to signal one another in hopes of evading Xenomorph detection. The foodstuff vindeedee stuffing shared its name with the vindeedee.
